lines.text: Jesus teaches beside the sea, sits in a boat because of the large crowd, and teaches many things in parables.
A farmer sows seed that falls on the path, rocky ground, thorns and good soil, and the good soil yields a crop.
Alone with the Twelve, Jesus says the mystery of the kingdom of God has been given to them.
Jesus explains that the farmer sows the word, and on the path, locusts come and take away the word.

wrong_details.wrong: locusts come and take away the word
wrong_details.true: Satan comes and takes away the word

lines.text: Jesus compares the kingdom of God to a mustard seed, which grows to be the largest of all garden plants, where cattle rest in its shade.

wrong_details.true: the birds of the air nest in its shade
